title: How to Change an Outfit in an Image with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Use a simple natural-language request in Claude, let MCP connect to Medux, upload a person image and a clothing reference, then download the generated outfit-swap result.
operation: Use a simple natural-language request in Claude, let MCP connect to Medux, upload a person image and a clothing reference, then download the generated outfit-swap result.
prompt: Using Medux, change the girl's outfit in girl.JPEG to match the clothing shown in clothes.PNG. Upload the files using a curl command.
